purpose: Source-informed catalogue briefs: 47 confirmed pieces, 2 suggested pieces, 2 unowned historical records. User corrections take precedence over the source guides.

global.style: Consistent premium ecommerce product photography, realistic fabric and natural seams, soft broad studio lighting, subtle grounding shadow, no dramatic highlights.
global.background: True transparent alpha background; no baked-in backdrop. Displayed on the app’s pale neutral surface.
global.layout: An exact equal-size invisible rectangular grid. One isolated garment or one matched shoe pair per cell, centered on that cell. No contact between cells and no garment crossing a boundary. No drawn cell borders, labels, numbers, text, branding overlays or ownership badges.
global.view: Clothing shown front-on, laid flat or evenly suspended without any visible hanger, model, body or mannequin. Buttons closed, sleeves symmetrically relaxed and slightly spread. Both trouser legs fully visible. Shoes are a matched pair in one gentle front three-quarter view.
global.safeArea: At least 10% empty space around each cell content. Values widthWithinCell/heightWithinCell are maximum relative extents including garment sleeves; do not crop sleeves, hems or toes. Never enlarge a small graphic to fill the cell.
global.graphicsPolicy: User-supplied product references and corrections take precedence. Reproduce referenced prints as closely as possible; do not invent readable wording where it is unknown. Plain garments stay plain. Solid brown flannel has no checks or stripes. See corrections/prompts.json for replacement cutouts and front/back artwork.
global.indexing: cells are row-major. index is zero-based; row and column are one-based. id:null is a deliberately empty background-only cell.
global.outputSuggestion: Generate enough pixels per cell for sharp product cards: 2048x2048 or larger for 4x4 atlases; 2048x1536 or larger for 4x3 atlases, with exact matching aspect ratio.
